description: Information system does not establish and manage cryptographic keys for required cryptography.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of formal key management procedures, lack of secure key generation processes, inadequate key storage mechanisms, no key rotation policies, missing key lifecycle management, weak key distribution methods, inadequate key destruction procedures, and no segregation of key management duties.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - System and Communications Protection
FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
